professors.name: Ian Reid
professors.title: Acting Vice Provost of Research and Senior Director of Research Administration, and Professor of Computer Vision
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Reid was Head of School and Professor of Computer Science at the University of Adelaide. The faculty directory also lists him as Department Chair and Professor of Computer Vision.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes contributions across active vision, visual SLAM, visual geometry, human motion capture, and visual surveillance, with current interests in spatial AI and embodied AI, including life-long visual learning, common-sense reasoning, and video understanding for real-time robotic decision-making.

professors.name: Fahad Khan
professors.title: Professor of Computer Vision
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Khan was a lead scientist at the Inception Institute of Artificial Intelligence (IIAI) in Abu Dhabi.
professors.research_summary: Official profile lists research interests in object recognition, detection, segmentation, tracking, and action recognition, with current work on learning visual recognition models with limited human supervision.

professors.name: Hao Li
professors.title: Dean of Undergraduate Division, Director of the Metaverse Center, and Professor of Computer Vision
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Li was a Distinguished Fellow of the Computer Vision Group at UC Berkeley and Associate Professor of Computer Science at the University of Southern California, where he was also director of the USC Institute for Creative Technologies.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research on deep learning and data-driven techniques for data capture and synthesis, geometry processing, multi-modal algorithms, and end-to-end systems for AR/VR and visual effects, including human digitization, neural rendering, and AI-media synthesis, manipulation, and detection.

professors.name: Salman Khan
professors.title: Associate Professor of Computer Vision
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that Professor Khan is a founding faculty member of MBZUAI and leads an independent research program in computer vision and multimodal AI.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research in computer vision and multimodal AI, including large multimodal models for images, video, and Earth observation; pixel-grounded vision-language models; geospatial and climate foundation models; and efficient, robust transformer architectures.
professors.recent_work_summary: Official profile lists selected recent work including Video-ChatGPT (ACL 2024) on detailed video understanding via large vision and language models.

professors.name: Hisham Cholakkal
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Computer Vision
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes work on multimodal learning, including foundation models and multimodal large language models.
professors.recent_work_summary: Official profile lists recent publications including BiMediX (Findings of EMNLP, 2024) and BiMediX2 (Findings of EMNLP, 2025) on bilingual and biomedical multimodal models.

professors.name: Mohammad Yaqub
professors.title: Associate Professor of Computer Vision
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Yaqub was a postdoctoral fellow for six years in the Institute of Biomedical Engineering at the University of Oxford.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research in AI in healthcare applied to medical image analysis (ultrasound, MRI, and CT), radiomics and radiogenomics, continual learning and adversarial robustness in healthcare, and healthcare challenges using natural language processing.

professors.name: Muhammad Haris Khan
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Computer Vision
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Khan was a research scientist at the Inception Institute of Artificial Intelligence (IIAI).
professors.research_summary: Official profile lists research interests in face-related tasks, visual domain adaptation and generalization, visual tracking, unsupervised learning for dense prediction, and human-object interaction detection.

professors.name: Ivan Laptev
professors.title: Associate Dean for Research and Professor of Computer Vision
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that Professor Laptev was appointed INRIA Research Scientist in 2005 and INRIA Research Director in 2013, and led the WILLOW research team at INRIA Paris between 2021 and 2023.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes recent work at the convergence of computer vision, natural language processing, and robotics, including vision-language navigation and vision-language manipulation, as well as video understanding and 3D reconstruction of humans, hands, and manipulated objects.

professors.name: Rao Muhammad Anwer
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Computer Vision
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Anwer was a research scientist at the Inception Institute of Artificial Intelligence (IIAI) in Abu Dhabi.
professors.research_summary: Official profile lists research interests in visual object recognition, pedestrian detection, action recognition, efficient and robust deep learning models for scene understanding, and human visual relationship detection.
professors.recent_work_summary: Official profile states current projects on integrated and detailed image understanding, and learning visual recognition models with limited human supervision.

professors.name: Timothy Baldwin
professors.title: Provost and Professor of Natural Language Processing
professors.research_summary: Official profile states that Professor Baldwin’s primary research focus is natural language processing, including deep learning, algorithmic fairness, computational social science, and social media analytics.

professors.name: Preslav Nakov
professors.title: Professor of Natural Language Processing
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Nakov was a principal scientist at the Qatar Computing Research Institute, HBKU.
professors.research_summary: Official profile lists research interests in computational linguistics and NLP, including disinformation, propaganda, fake news and media bias detection, fact checking, machine translation, question answering, sentiment analysis, lexical semantics, and biomedical text processing.

professors.name: Thamar Solorio
professors.title: Vice Provost of Faculty Excellence and Advancement, and Professor of Natural Language Processing
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Solorio was a Professor of Computer Science at the University of Houston and Director and Founder of the RiTUAL Lab there.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research on information extraction, multilingual models with emphasis on mixed-language settings, low-resource NLP, and multimodal content understanding.

professors.name: Alham Fikri Aji
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Natural Language Processing
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Aji was an applied research scientist at Amazon and a postdoctoral fellow at the University of Edinburgh.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research on efficient NLP through model compression and distillation, and NLP for under-resourced languages, including dataset construction, data-efficient learning, zero-shot approaches, and multilingual language models.

professors.name: Fajri Koto
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Natural Language Processing
professors.research_summary: Official profile states that Professor Koto’s research aims to enhance multilingual representation of language models using efficient techniques and transfer learning, including cultural adaptation in generative models, dialogue systems, fairness and trustworthiness, and NLP applications in education and health.
professors.recent_work_summary: Official profile lists recent publications including ArabicMMLU (Findings of ACL 2024) and related multilingual LLM evaluation work.

professors.name: Tatsuki Kuribayashi
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Natural Language Processing
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to his faculty role, Professor Kuribayashi was a postdoctoral researcher at Tohoku University and previously held a postdoctoral research position at MBZUAI.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes interdisciplinary research bridging NLP and the science of human language, including cognitive plausibility of NLP models and computational psycholinguistics.

professors.name: Artem Shelmanov
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Practice of Natural Language Processing
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes work on uncertainty quantification for large language models, including hallucination detection and related evaluation methods.
professors.recent_work_summary: Official profile lists recent publications including work on uncertainty quantification heads for hallucination detection (EMNLP 2025) and LM-Polygraph (TACL 2025 / EMNLP 2023).

professors.name: Le Song
professors.title: Professor of Machine Learning
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Song was an associate professor of computational science and engineering and associate director of the Center for Machine Learning at the Georgia Institute of Technology.
professors.research_summary: Official profile lists research interests in machine learning methods and algorithms for complex and dynamic data, including structured prediction, neuro-symbolic integration, and AI for healthcare and drug design.

professors.name: Kun Zhang
professors.title: Visiting Professor of Machine Learning
professors.biography: Official CIAI materials identify Dr. Kun Zhang as center director. Official faculty profile describes prior associate professorship at Carnegie Mellon University focused on machine learning, causal learning, and reasoning.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research in causal discovery and inference, causal representation learning, and machine learning under data heterogeneity.

professors.name: Nils Lukas
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Machine Learning
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that Professor Lukas received his Ph.D. from the University of Waterloo.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research on trustworthy ML systems, including controlling misuse of ML systems, reliability of generated outputs, aligned and explainable ML, confidential computing, robust watermarking of ML-generated content, and auditing differentially private language models.

professors.name: Samuel Horváth
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Machine Learning
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that Professor Horváth completed his M.Sc. (2018) and Ph.D. (2022) in statistics at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST).
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research at the intersection of mathematics, computer science, machine learning, optimization, and statistics, with a particular focus on federated learning.

professors.name: Zhiqiang Xu
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Machine Learning
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Xu was a senior research scientist with Baidu Research.
professors.research_summary: Official profile lists research interests at the intersection of numerical computation, stochastic optimization, and Riemannian optimization, as well as deep learning, clustering, community detection, and topic modeling.

professors.name: Steve Liu
professors.title: Professor of Computer Science and Machine Learning
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Liu was a Full Professor and William Dawson Scholar at McGill University.
professors.research_summary: Official profile lists interests in AI, machine learning and applications, intelligent computing and communications systems, sustainable computing, internet of things (IoT), and cyber-physical systems (CPS).

professors.name: Youcheng Sun
professors.title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Sun held faculty positions at The University of Manchester and Queen's University Belfast, and was a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Oxford.
professors.research_summary: Official profile states that Professor Sun pioneers safety and security techniques in AI-powered software systems, with recognition including the Alan Turing Institute UK-Italy Trustworthy AI Visiting Researcher Programme.

professors.name: Xiaosong Ma
professors.title: Senior Director of Research Infrastructure, Professor of Computer Science
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile states that prior to joining MBZUAI, Professor Ma worked as a principal scientist at Qatar Computing Research Institute and as an associate professor at North Carolina State University.
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research on efficient resource utilization across system layers, from CPU/GPU caches to datacenter-scale distributed storage, to better support applications including graph, database, and LLM processing.

professors.name: Eric Xing
professors.title: President and University Professor
professors.biography: Official MBZUAI profile and Computer Science department listing identify Professor Xing as MBZUAI President and University Professor. Official profile also states leadership of the Institute of Foundation Models (IFM).
professors.research_summary: Official profile describes research on machine learning and statistical methodology and large-scale computational systems for automated learning, reasoning, and decision-making, including foundation models and world models such as PAN and K2-Think, open LLM initiatives such as LLM360, Vicuna, and JAIS, and AI for science efforts including AI-Driven Digital Organisms (AIDO).
